result.summary: Found 4 issues, mainly related to layout cut-offs and text overlapping the promotional banner background.

issues.description: The third restaurant card 'Trattoria Piccolo' in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge of the screen, indicating horizontal scroll but no clear visual affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a partial peek indicator or fade edge to signal scrollability, or adjust card sizing to avoid abrupt cropping.

issues.description: The promotional banner text '3 free deliveries for you' and subtext appear low-contrast/faded against the light green background, making it harder to read.
issues.suggestion: Increase text color contrast or darken the banner background slightly for better legibility.

issues.description: The category filter row (Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) is cut off on the right side with an additional category partially visible, similar to the restaurant card row.
issues.suggestion: Add a scroll indicator or ensure consistent partial-card cropping to hint at more content.

issues.description: The pizza discount card at the bottom is cut off by the navigation bar, showing only part of the image and no visible restaurant name or details.
issues.suggestion: Adjust scroll spacing or padding so the card content is not obscured by the bottom navigation bar.
